triggerReason: A single cognitive Provider made homogeneity invisible, while switching Providers inside an active run would confound the experiment and could change resident outcomes without governed evidence.
action: Added a separately budgeted, schema-compatible read-only shadow Provider; persisted stable request, disagreement, failure, fallback-bias and billing evidence; exposed bilingual diversity and reliability panels; kept deterministic controls and proved that shadow output has no settlement path.
outcome: The local v4.5 gate completed 259 tests, 26 browser/axe scenarios, 365 Turns and 730 shadow comparisons with 356 disagreements (48.77%), zero shadow failures or stored reasoning and an exact control fingerprint. Provider substitution changed behavior while resource and severe safety invariants remained intact. Production deployment is pending.
evidence: Primary and shadow use versioned bounded contracts and stable caller IDs
Shadow has a separate monthly budget and no fallback authority
DeepSeek shadow billing contributes to the actual Token/cost ledger
Shadow failure and budget exhaustion do not pause or alter the city
365-Turn shadow and no-shadow world fingerprints are identical
Provider substitution preserves resource, consent, continuity and harm invariants
